content.text: Apple's first foldable iPhone goes on sale today in 70+ markets. The iPhone Duo has a 5.4-inch cover screen, a 7.6-inch inner display and a $1,999 US starting price. Apple has confirmed limited walk-in stock in several countries, including the UK and US. Check your local store before travelling: launch day doesn't mean guaranteed availability.

visual.headline: IPHONE DUO GOES ON SALE
visual.alt_text: Original dark editorial card reporting the October 23 launch of Apple's first foldable iPhone, with a 5.4-inch outer display, 7.6-inch inner display, and US starting price of $1,999. Source: Apple.
